trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
1. Earn every other trophy in the list.
2. The platinum unlocks the moment the last of the other 54 is earned.
3. Use the Roadmap tab to follow a clean order that overlaps activities with story progress.

Sources: 1, 2

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
1. Begin the story in Leonida.
2. Complete the opening mission "Gone Fishing" after the prologue.
3. It is part of Chapter 1 and cannot be missed.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
1. Play through all of Chapter 1's missions.
2. The trophy pops on the chapter's closing card.
3. Purely story-gated.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
1. Complete every mission in Chapter 2.
2. Unlocks at the chapter's end.
3. No optional material required.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
1. Work through Chapter 3's mission chain.
2. Earns on the chapter's finale.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
1. Finish all of Chapter 4.
2. The trophy arrives with the chapter wrap-up.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide:
1. Clear all story chapters to unlock the finale.
2. Beat the final mission to end the main story.
3. Save at a checkpoint before the finale if you want to replay choices.

Sources: 1, 2

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
1. Unlock and play the mission "Breakfast Run" early in the story.
2. Complete its objectives to clear it.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
1. Progress the story to "The Cartel Heist".
2. Finish the heist with its required objectives.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
1. Play the story mission "Child's Play".
2. Complete it to earn the trophy.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
1. Unlock "Headliners" in the story.
2. Finish the mission successfully.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
1. Reach the "VCIA Takedown" story mission.
2. Complete it to unlock the trophy.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
1. Progress to "Operation Savage Glory".
2. Clear the mission to earn it.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
1. Reach 100% total completion across story, side content, collectibles, and activities.
2. Check the in-game progress menu to see exactly what remains.
3. Finish every collectible, stranger strand, and activity from the Completionist Cleanup stage.

Sources: 1, 2, 5

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
1. Perform stunts while driving vehicles across the map.
2. A stunt is counted when you pull off mid-air tricks or land big jumps.
3. Grind ramps and jump points to total 250.

Sources: 1, 5

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
1. There are several activity types: races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, meditation, and more.
2. Start one instance of each distinct type.
3. The trophy counts types touched, not completions.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
1. Visit every shooting range location.
2. Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges.
3. Headshots and speed push your score to gold.

Sources: 1, 3

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
1. Find all 14 Top Fun drone-race locations.
2. Win the race at each one to register it.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
1. Enter street races scattered across the map.
2. Win 20 distinct events; repeats don't add to the count.

Sources: 1, 5

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
1. Meet Cal through his stranger interaction near the water.
2. Accept his fishing challenge.
3. Use bait suited to the target species and out-catch him.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
1. Find a playable arcade cabinet in the world.
2. Play and beat a single arcade game.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Andy's full stranger strand from the first task to his last.
2. His final mission unlocks only after his earlier jobs are done.
3. Do this before finishing the story to be safe.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete Kenton's stranger strand step by step.
2. His finale unlocks after all earlier tasks.
3. Clear it before the story's end if possible.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
1. Follow Billy's stranger strand to its last mission.
2. Complete the finale to earn the trophy.
3. Ideally finish before the main story wraps.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Locate stranger icons across the map.
2. Complete 8 entire strands, a strand being one character's whole questline.
3. You can mix and match any characters.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
1. Work through Randy's strand to his final mission.
2. Complete it to unlock the trophy.
3. Finish before the story ends to avoid locking it out.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete Tyrone's strand up to his finale.
2. Beat his last mission to earn it.
3. Best done before the story's finale.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Find all 18 meditation spots marked on the map.
2. Sit at each one so it registers.

Sources: 1, 5

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
1. Take Bret's hunting contract.
2. Track the unique named animal to its territory.
3. Kill it and report back to complete the hunt.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
1. Collect trading cards hidden around the world.
2. Assemble three complete sets.
3. Use the collection menu to track gaps.

Sources: 1, 5

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
1. Use the WAiNK action at 100 distinct spots.
2. Look for stencil and sticker marks scattered across the map.

Sources: 1, 5

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
1. Open the Challenges menu from the pause screen.
2. Complete 50 individual challenge objectives.
3. Many overlap with normal play.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
1. Raise a 4-star wanted level with your partner alongside you.
2. Lose the cops and escape the heat together.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
1. With your partner, rob three shops in a row.
2. Keep your wanted level alive between each hit.
3. Plan a quick route between stores.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide:
1. Discover 100 different vehicles by driving or stealing them.
2. Track your garage/inventory list for gaps.

Sources: 1, 5

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
1. Build up Combat Focus in a gunfight.
2. During one activation, take down five enemies.
3. Aim for headshots to chain kills in the slow-mo window.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
1. Head to VCIA airport.
2. Steal a plane or helicopter parked on the tarmac.
3. Take off before security can stop you.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
1. Obtain a Rhino military tank, via a military base or event.
2. Use it to wreck targets / survive combat.
3. The trophy pops from the rioting/famous moment.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
1. Enter a jewelry store.
2. Rob it while staying undetected.
3. Silent takedowns and staying out of camera view help.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
1. Infiltrate banks and crack their vaults.
2. Grab the cash and escape cleanly.
3. Do this five times.

Sources: 1, 3

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
1. Spot an armored truck on the streets.
2. Stop it, breach the doors, and grab the cash.
3. Escape the police response.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
1. Unfog the whole map by driving and flying over every area.
2. Reveal all 52 named regions.

Sources: 1, 5

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
1. Hit one illegal operation (stash, meth lab, etc.) per gang.
2. There are nine gangs with marked operations.
3. Check the map for gang-operation icons.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
1. Go to Ocean Beach.
2. Order a cocktail and sit to enjoy the view.
3. The trophy pops as you take in the beach.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
1. Enter a dealership showroom.
2. Steal a display vehicle.
3. Smash through the glass front to escape.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
1. Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
2. Play a frame and knock down pins with good follow-through.
3. A strike or spare earns it.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide:
1. Progress the central partnership storyline.
2. Reach the key relationship moment that draws public attention.

Sources: 1, 2

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide:
1. Make significant decisions during the story.
2. Choices shape reputation and endings.
3. Different runs see different outcomes.

Sources: 1, 2

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide:
1. Fail a mission or activity once.
2. Succeed on the retry.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide:
1. Track the strange mystery events in the world.
2. Complete the related optional investigation chain.

Sources: 1, 4

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
1. Drive alongside a pedestrian or group.
2. Melee-attack from the moving vehicle to knock them down.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
1. Collect marked bills from robberies and missions.
2. Pass them through your laundering contacts.
3. Accumulate $250,000 laundered in total.

Sources: 1, 3

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
1. Shop at clothing, weapon, and other stores.
2. Spend $100,000 in total across all of them.

Sources: 1, 6

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide:
1. Buy all 8 garage properties.
2. Save up, as they are expensive.
3. Use property income to fund the purchases.

Sources: 1, 5

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
1. Open the Scooter Bros app in-game.
2. Register ten different vehicles through it.
3. Mix scooters, bikes, and cars for variety.

Sources: 1, 6
